teaser.en: The easiest citrus to peel: the tangerine's loose skin slips off in one piece.
teaser.sw: Ni rahisi kumenya kuliko machungwa yote: ganda legevu la chenza hutoka kwa kipande kimoja.
teaser.dg: Kahi ya matunda ga jamii ya machungbwa, *chendza* ndiyo rahisi zaidi kuguwa: gadare ririrolegea rinauka rosi kpwa chipande chimwenga.

summary.en: *Mchendza* is the tangerine or mandarin, a small citrus tree with sweet, easy-peeling fruit. It is grown on farms and around homesteads for fresh fruit.
summary.sw: *Mchendza* ni mchenza, mti mdogo wa jamii ya machungwa wenye matunda matamu yanayomenyeka kwa urahisi. Hupandwa mashambani na kuzunguka makazi kwa ajili ya matunda.
summary.dg: *Mchendza* ni muhi mdide wa jamii ya machungbwa, wenye matunda ga mtswano ganagoguwika kpwa urahisi. Nkuphandwa mindani na kanda-kanda ya midzi ili kuphaha matunda ga kurya dza garivyo.

about.en:
*Mchendza* is a small, evergreen citrus tree, sometimes thorny, with glossy, fragrant leaves and white, sweet-scented flowers.

The fruits are smaller and flatter than oranges, with a thin, loose skin that peels away easily. Inside, the segments separate cleanly and are sweet and juicy.
about.sw:
*Mchendza* ni mti mdogo wa jamii ya machungwa, wa kijani kibichi mwaka mzima, wakati mwingine wenye miiba, wenye majani yanayong'aa yenye harufu nzuri na maua meupe yenye harufu tamu.

Matunda yake ni madogo na bapa zaidi kuliko machungwa, yenye ganda jembamba na legevu linalomenyeka kwa urahisi. Ndani, vipande vyake hutengana vizuri na ni vitamu vyenye maji mengi.
about.dg:
*Mchendza* ni muhi mdide wa jamii ya machungbwa wenye makodza chila wakati. Wakati wanjina una miya. Makodzage ganang'arira na gana arufu nono, na maruwage ni mereru, genye arufu nono.

Matunda ni madide na mabapa kuriko machungbwa, na gadare ni dzembamba na rinalegea, kpwa hivyo rinaguwika kpwa urahisi. Ndani, vipande vinatengana sawa-sawa na ni vya mtswano na vina madzi manji.

where.en: *Mchendza* grows on farms and around homesteads, often alongside oranges and limes.
where.sw: *Mchendza* hukua mashambani na kuzunguka makazi, mara nyingi pamoja na michungwa na midimu.
where.dg: *Mchendza* unamera mindani na kanda-kanda ya midzi, mara nyinji phamwenga na michungbwa na mindimu.

names.en: Digo: *mchendza*. Swahili: *mchenza*. English: tangerine or mandarin. Scientists call it *Citrus reticulata*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mchendza*. Kiswahili: *mchenza*. Kwa Kiingereza: *tangerine* au *mandarin*. Wanasayansi huuita *Citrus reticulata*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo ni *mchendza*. Kpwa Chiswahili ni *mchenza*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *tangerine* au *mandarin*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Citrus reticulata*.
